title: Procedure call from inside a function body — Tier 4.3 pass-8
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Concurrent assign `y <= invoke_xor(a, b);` where the user function body calls a procedure `xor_p(x, z, t)` that writes an out-mode variable parameter, then returns `not t`. Pass-8 adds ProcedureCallStatement.ResolveBoundBodyAgainstScope: builds rename map, substitutes formals in BodyRaw, reparses against the runtime's localScope + cloned procedure locals. FunctionExecutor.ExecuteFunctionBody dispatches ProcedureCallStatement through this new resolver so out-mode variable writes reach caller-scope Variables. Complements pass-5's synth-side scaffold. Bench passes on VCD equality against GHDL byte-for-byte.
